message.content: A nonstop commercial flight from Los Angeles (LAX) to Miami (MIA) typically takes about **5 ½ to 6 hours** of air time, depending on wind conditions and the specific aircraft. If you’re looking at scheduled times, most airlines list a flight duration of roughly **5 hours 30 minutes** to **6 hours**.
